model_name: Standing volume under constant management (worked example)
research_question: How does standing volume evolve over 50 years under constant management?
inputs_data: Initial volume; growth, harvest and mortality rates
parameter_origin: Fitted on national forest inventory plots, 1990-2020
uncertainty: None; a single deterministic trajectory, no interval
access_licence: Not distributed; fifteen lines shown in class
reproducibility: Full; the code fits on one slide
strengths: Transparent, instant, easy to argue about
limits: No species, no spatial detail, no climate effect
domain_of_validity: Climate and management regime close to those of the calibration period
typology_position: Kelly et al. 2013 would file it under system dynamics; purpose class is prediction in the sense of Edmonds et al. 2019
what_does_not_fit: Kelly's five approaches were written for integrated assessment models. This one is a three-equation stock-and-flow, so the label is borrowed rather than earned.
